<function name="OnPlayerPhysicsDrop" parent="GM" type="hook">
	<added>2021.01.27</added>
	<description>Called when a player +use drops an entity.</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="ply" type="Player">The player that dropped the object</arg>
		<arg name="ent" type="Entity">The object that was dropped.</arg>
		<arg name="thrown" type="boolean">Whether the object was throw or simply let go of.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
